import java.util.*;

public class MaxFlowSolver {
    static final int N = 15;
    static final int MAX_VERTICES = 2 * N * N + 2;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int v, cap, rev;
        Edge(int v, int cap, int rev) {
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    List<Edge>[] graph = new ArrayList[MAX_VERTICES];

    int[] level = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
    int[] iter = new int[MAX_VERTICES];

    int n, T;
    char[][] grid = new char[N][N];
    char[][] capsule = new char[N][N];
    int[][] Z = new int[N][N];
    int[][] S = new int[N][N];
    int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    int s_node, t_node;

    public MaxFlowSolver() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VERTICES; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph[u].add(new Edge(v, cap, graph[v].size()));
        graph[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, graph[u].size() - 1));
    }

    void init() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VERTICES; i++) {
            graph[i].clear();
        }
    }

    boolean buildLevelGraph(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        queue.offer(s);
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int u = queue.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.v] < 0) {
                    level[e.v] = level[u] + 1;
                    queue.offer(e.v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0;
    }

    int sendFlow(int u, int t, int flow) {
        if (u == t) return flow;
        for (; iter[u] < graph[u].size(); iter[u]++) {
            Edge e = graph[u].get(iter[u]);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.v] == level[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = sendFlow(e.v, t, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    graph[e.v].get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (buildLevelGraph(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
            int flow;
            while ((flow = sendFlow(s, t, INF)) > 0) {
                totalFlow += flow;
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    boolean inside(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n;
    }

    void runBFS(int x, int y, int[][] distMap, boolean mark, int startX, int startY) {
        for (int[] row : distMap) {
            Arrays.fill(row, 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        distMap[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y});
        if (mark && isDigit(capsule[x][y])) {
            addEdge(startX * n + startY, startX * n + startY + n * n, INF);
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] pos = q.poll();
            int cx = pos[0], cy = pos[1];
            if (distMap[cx][cy] == T) break;
            for (int o = 0; o < 4; o++) {
                int xx = cx + dx[o], yy = cy + dy[o];
                if (inside(xx, yy) && distMap[xx][yy] == 0x3f3f3f3f && capsule[xx][yy] != 'Y') {
                    if (Z[xx][yy] > distMap[cx][cy] + 1 || (Z[xx][yy] == distMap[cx][cy] + 1 && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy]))) {
                        distMap[xx][yy] = distMap[cx][cy] + 1;
                        if (mark && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                            addEdge(startX * n + startY, xx * n + yy + n * n, INF);
                        }
                        if (Z[xx][yy] > distMap[cx][cy] + 1 || !mark) {
                            q.offer(new int[]{xx, yy});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    boolean isDigit(char ch) {
        return ch >= '1' && ch <= '9';
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        MaxFlowSolver solver = new MaxFlowSolver();

        solver.n = sc.nextInt();
        solver.T = sc.nextInt();

        int s_node = solver.n * solver.n * 2;
        int t_node = s_node + 1;
        solver.s_node = s_node;
        solver.t_node = t_node;

        solver.init();

        int xZ = -1, yZ = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < solver.n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < solver.n; j++) {
                solver.grid[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (solver.grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    xZ = i;
                    yZ = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < solver.n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < solver.n; j++) {
                solver.capsule[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (solver.isDigit(solver.capsule[i][j])) {
                    int cap = solver.capsule[i][j] - '0';
                    solver.addEdge(solver.n * solver.n + i * solver.n + j, t_node, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        solver.runBFS(xZ, yZ, solver.Z, false, -1, -1);

        for (int i = 0; i < solver.n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < solver.n; j++) {
                if (solver.isDigit(solver.grid[i][j])) {
                    int cap = solver.grid[i][j] - '0';
                    solver.addEdge(s_node, i * solver.n + j, cap);
                    solver.runBFS(i, j, solver.S, true, i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solver.maxFlow(s_node, t_node));
        sc.close();
    }
}
